code: import axios from"axios";const api=axios.create({baseURL:process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL||"http://localhost:8080",withCredentials:true,headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"}});export async function getCurrentUser(){const response=await api.get("/api/auth/me");return response.data;}export async function logout(){await api.post("/logout");}export async function getAdminPing(){const response=await api.get("/api/admin/ping");return response.data;}export async function getUserPing(){const response=await api.get("/api/user/ping");return response.data;}export function getGoogleLoginUrl(){return`${api.defaults.baseURL}/oauth2/authorization/google`;}export default api;
